name: summarize
summary: Summarize processed starter note metadata into a deterministic one-line summary.
description: Reference app capability for the traverse-starter multi-capability pipeline showcase (spec 058-workflow-pipeline-execution). Genuinely composes the provided title/noteType/status/suggestedNextAction/tags fields into a one-line summary string and counts its actual words -- distinct inputs produce distinct summaries and word counts, deterministically. This replaces the 1.0.1 fixture, which always returned the same hardcoded summary and wordCount regardless of input. Built no_std on the shared agents/wasi-agent-runtime/ shim: verified to import only wasi_snapshot_preview1::{fd_read, fd_write, proc_exit}, so it is genuinely executable by Traverse's runtime, not just a generic wasmtime host. Source: agents/traverse-starter-summarize/ in this repo.

preconditions.description: The caller provides the traverse-starter.process output fields for one note.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a summary string and wordCount genuinely derived from the provided fields -- distinct inputs produce distinct outputs, deterministically.

side_effects.description: Produces a deterministic summary from the provided input.
